correctness.rationale: Regrouping coordinates along the gcd(n,v) cycles gives an exact product of ordinary chi maps; the second family is blockwise conjugate by the explicit affine involution z_t -> 1+z_{-t}. The two branches of the classified general map reduce to these explicit families by input/output coordinate shifts. Published ordinary-chi inverse and iterate theorems then give the inverse degree and dynamics. Exhaustive checks confirm the block identities, representative inverse degrees and representative orders.

originality.rationale: The recent source classifies the permutations, introduces the shift cycles in its collision analysis, and remarks only that the explicit families have similar iterate behavior. The inspected v1 does not state the direct-product affine classification, the exact tau(n0)-1 class count, or the transferred inverse-degree formula. Targeted external and SCOPE searches found no equivalent statement. Originality remains to the best of our knowledge, with material folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk because the decomposition is short and the motivating preprint is very recent.

value.rationale: The result shows that the new even-dimensional permutations are parallel repetitions of smaller odd chi blocks rather than irreducible n-bit nonlinear layers. It bounds inverse degree by the odd part of n, compresses the parameterized family to divisor-many affine types, and transfers exact order and iterate information for the explicit families.
